fields.title: PHASE 2 — 10-Year Milestones (2027–2036)
fields.md:
| ID | Axis | Year | Milestone (Yes/No) | Current (2026-09-30) | If achieved | If missed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A-2027-1 | Insurance | 2027 | Annual after-tax insurance underwriting profit | 9M26 +$4.80 billion | Float cost stays negative | Float becomes paid borrowing |
| A-2027-2 | Insurance | 2027 | GEICO annual loss ratio at or below 75% | 76.6% (3Q26) | Losses controlled amid price competition | Leans toward D1 materializing |
| A-2028-1 | Insurance | 2028 | Float of $190 billion or more | $178.5 billion | Larger investment funding base | Insurance growth stalls |
| A-2029-1 | External | 2029 | GEICO annual combined ratio ≤ Progressive | Definition not finalized | AI underwriting disadvantage resolved | Structural disadvantage |
| B-2027-1 | Operations | 2027 | BNSF annual after-tax earnings of $6.5 billion or more | TTM $6.01 billion | Railroad competitiveness restored | Operations axis revised downward |
| B-2028-1 | Operations | 2028 | BHE annual after-tax earnings of $5.0 billion or more | TTM $4.31 billion | Wildfire burden overcome | Regulation and wildfires erode earnings |
| B-2030-1 | Operations | 2030 | Manufacturing, services and retail annual after-tax earnings of $20.0 billion or more | TTM $15.08 billion | Earnings engine expands | Stagnation |
| C-2027-1 | Capital allocation | 2027 | Headline cash ÷ total assets at or below 25% | 28.9% | Cash deployment under way | Cash left idle |
| C-2027-2 | Capital allocation | 2027 | Annual share repurchases of $20.0 billion or more | 2026 9M $14.41 billion | Return-of-capital axis strengthens | Company judges shares expensive relative to intrinsic value |
| C-2028-1 | Capital allocation | 2028 | Completion of a single acquisition of $20.0 billion or more | Largest $9.4 billion | Large-scale deployment | Cash axis weak |
| D-2027-1 | Portfolio | 2027 | Annual net stock purchases > 0 | 2026 9M +$11.2 billion | Net-buying phase continues | Judgment that prices are a burden |
| D-2030-1 | Portfolio | 2030 | Top-5 holdings concentration at or below 75% | 66% (end of June) | Concentration controlled | Thematic concentration |
| E-2027-1 | Succession | 2027 | 2026–2027 Class B return within −10%p of the S&P 500 | +5.8%p (year to date) | No succession discount | Discount materializes |
| E-2028-1 | Succession/External | 2028 | PacifiCorp cumulative estimated losses of $5.0 billion or less | $2.85 billion | Wildfires manageable | BHE value impaired |

Source: Current values come from each source in PHASE 1 (3Q26 press release, 10-Q, Forbes). TTM is the sum of the latest four quarters (formula, table 1-1). For how to verify, see the milestone check column in state.
